technical_gates_before_future_ml_export_.requirement: M3BD currently has no retained labels. Future ML work needs a nonempty training-worthy subset or explicit human-approved data/source/label repair.
Paid Brev work requires current auth, worker/cost/runtime/kill-condition/teardown receipt, and no duplicate workers.
Browser activation requires trained scratch artifact, signer-disjoint metrics, negative challenge results, model-card promotion, and final claim matrix update.
Promoted recognition lane must keep pretrained_components empty.

technical_gates_before_product_runtime_i.requirement: The next implementation prompt must name exact product surfaces and preserve model-card not_trained status, activeLabels [], and active_cv_claim null.
Any product implementation must run final-claim, lesson fail-closed, avatar no-claim, practice screen, relevant smoke receipt audits, typecheck, build, and browser QA as applicable.
Raw camera frames must stay local; persisted attempts must remain metadata-only while not_trained.
Product runtime must not save passed=true from recognizer logic while model-card.status is not_trained.
